# Canary — world risk status as_of 2026-11-12T17:53Z · next run ~23:40 UK · stale after 2026-11-13T07:53Z (36h for daily-tier signals) Assessed by an AI model (Anthropic Claude) against published rubrics; attention levels, not forecasts or advice. CC BY 4.0 · https://canary.danleech.com Basis: 27 measured from open data, 11 follow a published figure, 51 are AI judgements from news reports (weigh these with more caution). Known limitations: https://canary.danleech.com/methodology#known-limits
World State 39/100 (Unsettled) · 14 Alert · 43 Watch · 32 Normal Headline: Hormuz stays shut as more tankers are hit on 11–12 Nov while US envoys meet in Moscow; Ebola in DR Congo passes 11,000 cases, Sudan's war grinds on and the France–Bund spread nears 150bp.
## Situations (7 cross-domain events; Alerts below are grouped under them) - US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock [ALERT, stable]: Iran says Hormuz stays shut pending its conditions; tankers hit by explosions 11–12 Nov, IRGC claims mines; US blockade holds. → alert: gulf-iran, middle-east, eu-gas, chokepoints, freight; watch: iran-nuclear, sanctions, oil, fertiliser, uk-energy-cap, semiconductors - Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank [ALERT, stable]: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner arrived in Moscow on 12 Nov; Russia launched 123 drones overnight 11–12 Nov; drones crossed Baltic airspace 10–11 Nov. → alert: russia-ukraine; watch: russia-nato, nuclear-plants - Super El Niño [ALERT, worsening]: ONI +2.46 for Aug–Oct; global temperature +1.99°C on 5 Nov, a record for the date; CO₂ growth 3.36 ppm/yr. → alert: enso, global-temp, co2; watch: drought, famine - Ebola outbreak, DR Congo [ALERT, worsening]: DR Congo Ebola at 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths on 11 Nov (health ministry via AP); WHO emergency since 17 May; Kenya 9 cases, Nigeria 1. → alert: ebola; watch: who-emergencies - Sudan war [ALERT, worsening]: RSF drone strike killed 9 in Blue Nile (reported 10 Nov); army advancing in West Kordofan; FEWS NET sees famine risk spreading in South Darfur. → alert: sudan; watch: famine - France: debt stress and protests [WATCH, worsening]: France–Bund 10-year spread about 149bp on 12 Nov, just under the 150bp Alert line, up from 142bp on 10 Nov; protests continue. → watch: sovereign-debt, civil-unrest - Energy shock feeding inflation [WATCH, worsening]: US October CPI +0.4% m/m (10 Nov), a Fed rise in December expected; BoE at 4% since 5 Nov; 10-year gilt near 5.22% on 11 Nov. → watch: us-inflation, central-banks, uk-rates, bond-volatility, gilts; normal: em-stress
## Other Alerts - Cholera & mosquito-borne [cholera-dengue] stable, AI-judged: WHO counts over 3,000 cholera deaths in 2026, nearly nine in ten in Africa; DR Congo led new deaths in October - Major cyber incidents [cyber] stable, AI-judged: France blamed an IRGC unit on 9 Nov for attacks on refrigeration in about 700 stores that caused at least 15 fires - UK terrorism threat level [uk-threat-level] stable, AI-judged: UK national terrorism threat level Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely; no change found as of 12 Nov
## Changed in last 24h - Sovereign debt stress [sovereign-debt]: ALERT→WATCH — France–Bund 10-year spread about 147bp on 10 Nov, back below the 150bp Alert line from a 174.6bp peak on 22 Oct (2026-11-11T17:56Z) - US equity stress [equity-stress]: WATCH→NORMAL — VIX 17.7 and S&P 500 2.4% below its high on 11 Nov, both inside Normal lines after a 3.8% weekly rise (2026-11-11T17:56Z)
## Watch (ids; detail at /s/{id}.md) bond-volatility, gold, private-credit, us-inflation, central-banks, sovereign-debt, oil, food-prices, critical-minerals, fertiliser, nuclear-plants, us-china, russia-nato, iran-nuclear, korea, trade-war, sanctions, hybrid-threats, drc-east, sahel, myanmar, india-pakistan, nuclear-risk, other-conflicts, heat, drought, sea-ice, who-emergencies, mpox, measles, respiratory, medicine-shortages, cables-gnss, semiconductors, ai-governance, exploited-vulns, famine, civil-unrest, aid-funding, uk-rates, gilts, uk-energy-cap, uk-disruption
## Sentiment (measured from open data; context only, never changes a status) News tone vs own past 6 months (GDELT, 7 days to 2026-11-11; number = % of past weeks less negative): gloomier: economy (94), tech (99); brighter: energy (5), climate (3), disasters (0); typical: conflict, trade, health, migration Consumer confidence (OECD, long-run avg 100): OECD 98.4 (2026-09), GBR 100.9 (2026-09), USA 96.1 (2026-09), EA20 98.3 (2026-09), JPN 98.5 (2026-09), CHN 95.4 (2026-07), IND 101.3 (2026-06) Uncertainty: US policy uncertainty 1.1× its 1-year median · Geopolitical risk in the news 1.0× its 1-year median · Market fear (VIX) higher than 58% of the past year
